test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e49bce5431ad8e3ee3cc838065df90cf03b27a596c0c37484a6a2714b940e3f5.png]
solution:
In the question figure,

1. The three-angled shape is rotating in an anti-clockwise direction.

2. The circle is filled first and then next is hollow and moves in a clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee6aa1c37b4ad458e93ea197ce73abf54739cbfb95cc15306d553f61ae34f337.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**
